name: 引用と写真を添える文脈付き返信
prompt:
Generate one faithful, high-resolution horizontal mobile composer screenshot matching the Japanese Lighthouse native preview. Keep the canvas ratio exactly 390:144 and show only this composer, with no surrounding app page, browser chrome, or extra content. The original source region is only 390×89, but the native Japanese adaptation is 390×144; follow the native preview's taller spacing.

Preserve the exact Japanese text and positions from the native preview: at the upper left, the muted gray thread prompt 「みんなの読書会」へのメッセージ; below it, the muted gray placeholder 「返信を入力してください」. Along the lower left, keep the small gray image-attachment icon followed by the gray quotation/reply-context icon. At the lower right, keep the forest-green circular send button with the simple white paper-plane arrow. Use a clean white surface, the same compact spacing and light visual weight as the native preview, and readable Meiryo-like Japanese text. Keep the button and icons aligned exactly as shown.

Use the original Fable screenshot only to understand the source composer controls and their order. The Japanese native preview controls the adapted wording, dimensions, Lighthouse colors, and exact layout. This screen contains no hyperlink text; do not add any blue links, extra labels, emoji, borders, shadows, avatars, photos, or other controls.
reviewNotes: 第1版を目視。2行の日本語と画像/引用/送信アクションの順序・横配置を保持。native preview比で引用アイコンが角張った¶風で、送信円に余分なテクスチャと陰影があり、紙飛行機も大きめ。緑色と各コントロールの相対位置は読み取れる。needs-correctionで保持。所有者受入・ネイティブ編集・実動作は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
